installCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')) cp.execSync('npm install && npm --prefix frontend install', {stdio:'inherit'}); else cp.execSync('npm install', {stdio:'inherit'});"
buildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/package.json')) cp.execSync('npm --prefix frontend run build', {stdio:'inherit'}); else cp.execSync('npm run build', {stdio:'inherit'});"
